reason: A DSH Web channel plugin that integrates Tencent iLink WeChat for cross-device chat, session and workspace control, event streaming, tool approvals, and media exchange.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH Web 会话接入腾讯 iLink 微信，支持跨端对话、工作区与会话切换、命令执行、审批转发及媒体收发。
summaries.en: Connects DSH Web sessions to Tencent iLink WeChat for cross-device chat, workspace and session control, command handling, approval forwarding, and media exchange.

capabilities: Connects to the Tencent iLink WeChat channel using QR-based authentication
Relays chat messages and session events between WeChat and DSH Web
Creates, switches, and attaches DSH workspaces and sessions
Executes supported DSH harness commands from WeChat
Forwards tool approval prompts and accepts approval or rejection replies
Sends local files to WeChat and downloads received media to local storage
Allows the agent to proactively send messages to WeChat
